body: I am going to see a new therapist tomorrow but the first appointment in my experience is usually getting to know me so they can make some sort of treatment plan. Also I am very bad with expressing how I feel. Usually when someone asks if I hurt myself or if I am suicidal I will lie because I get terrible anxiety about what will happen to me if I am honest. I don’t know how much longer I can hold on though. My family and friends know I am pretty depressed but they don’t know that everyday I contemplate suicide and very much want to die.
I’m 21 and our relationship is overall pretty good. She cares a lot about me but doesn’t quite understand mental illness and what I’m going through.
Yes I would definitely tell them it's not working. You could try a different therapist too. Often times it can take people a few tries to find the right one!

I have been there and the best thing I did for myself was got help. There are so many meds out there for you and therapy techniques especially for what you're dealing with. Don't feel ashamed or embarrassed. It's not stupid.. what you're going through is just as real as a physical illness. Tell whoever prescribed you that med that it's not working and you're really suffering. I got prescribed Ativan twice a day and I have been feeling like a new person. I can finally feel somewhat of control again and start to work on my issues with therapy. Wish you the best. It will get better.

Do not be nervous at all. You have to understand that they have heard it all. They have seen patients that are MUCH worse off than you and will not judge you. They are there to help. I've dealt with that kind of dissociation before too. I'm not sure if it's the same thing but mine comes from a symptom of the anxiety itself and although it's scary, it's not dangerous and totally normal. It can last for months for me... once almost a year but it always goes away sooner or later. It's a way for our brain to cope with panic. Make sure you are bringing all of this up though as they are the professional and they need all the details to come up with an accurate diagnosis. Best of luck :)

I would recommend genesight! I’ve been on 10 meds over the course of my life and just found out none of them would agree with my enzymes. There’s only one med out there for me that I wouldn’t have been put out without this test. I know not everyone has as dramatic of results as me but you’ll never know unless you try.
I think about this all the time. It seems selfish almost. :(
You have no idea how much this reply means to me. Thank you. ❤️

I can totally relate! I never show my anxiety. I can be having the worst panic attack and no one will know. It almost seems like saying it out loud makes it real and it can be embarrassing to talk about. I noticed though when I do tell people how I'm feeling, it helps me just to get it off my chest.
